---
title: "Session 6 · Tidy data and dplyr"
subtitle: "Express a transparent row-and-column pipeline"
---

## Learning goals

Recognize tibbles and pipes, use the core dplyr verbs and column-selection
helpers—including `if_else()`, `case_when()`, and `across()`—distinguish grouped
mutation from grouped summarization, and translate a pipeline into base R logic.

## Materials

- [Slides](slides.qmd)
- [Guided lab](lab.qmd)
- Lab starter—choose one: `starter/dplyr-lab.Rmd` or `starter/dplyr-lab.qmd`

This lab practices dplyr for the main analysis and checks one result with base R.
The optional extension recreates the analysis table in base R. This targeted
practice does not change the course's general flexibility to use either style.
